_doc: Stream E (P17). A map mark for every story quest: the giver and each step, WORLD metres + the world zone id + a radius (an area for kill/collect steps: the hunting area of that type js/sim/hunts.js picks — re-pointed by tools/content-hunts.mjs). Shown by the tracker, the journal and the map next to each step's `where` text (data/quests/<zone>.json). null = nowhere fixed. Made by tools/place-vignettes.mjs from the placements; re-run after a re-bake.
